_readme: Edit this file to configure the site. You do not need to touch any other file for normal updates.
tagline: Two leagues. One ladder. No mercy.

rules._comment: Both ladders are decided in the postseason brackets, not the regular-season table.
rules.summary: Premier League: the top 6 make the playoffs. The other 4 drop into a consolation bracket and only its winner stays up — the other 3 are relegated. G.R.I.T. League: only the top 4 make the playoffs, and 3 of those 4 are promoted — the champion, the runner-up and the winner of the third-place game.
rules.premierNote: Finish in the top 6 and you are safe. Finish 7th to 10th and you have to win the consolation bracket to survive.
rules.gritNote: Only the top 4 reach the playoffs, and 3 of them go up. Finish 5th and you are done. Reach the final and you are promoted; lose the semi-final and the third-place game decides it.

payouts._comment: One combined pot across both leagues. buyIn is per team; prizes must sum to the pot.
payouts.notes: $50 per team across both leagues. Every dollar is paid out to the four places above.

history._comment: Seed pre-site history here. h2h entries are all-time records BEFORE this season; the site adds this season automatically.
